perf.summary: Remove the unused 'using System;' (and in Imos2D) to keep translation units clean; not a perf change but reduces noise. The Build loop itself is already an optimal single-pass prefix sum.
perf.currentCost: using System; is imported but System is unused in Imos1D.cs; harmless but unnecessary. The prefix-sum loop is already minimal (one read, one write, one add per element) and correct.
perf.proposedChange: Drop the unused using. No change to the loop — it is already the canonical scalar prefix sum. Note: prefix sums are inherently serial (carry dependency), so SIMD would require a parallel-prefix rewrite that is usually not worth it for int on mobile; leaving scalar is the right call.
perf.rationale: Purely hygiene/ergonomics; confirms the hot loop is already optimal so no cycles are left on the table here.
perf.risk: None. This is the lowest-value item; included only to certify Imos1D.Build needs no algorithmic change.
